LanguageData.Build_Type89GD.label: Build Type 89 grenade discharger
LanguageData.Build_Type89GD.description: Builds the Type 89 grenade discharger, not as effective as a rocket launcher, but can still easily penetrate any armor.\nCaliber: 50mm GD shell/grenades
LanguageData.Build_FFB.label: Build Fliegerfaust B(R)
LanguageData.Build_FFB.description: Builds the Fliegerfaust B(Replica) multi-barreled Anti-Aircraft launchers, rumors said their performance counter infantry is better than the army though.\nCaliber: 20mm Fliegerfaust Mini Rockets
LanguageData.Build_FGM148J.label: Build a FGM-148 Javelin
LanguageData.Build_FGM148J.description: Builds the FGM-148 Javelin Fire-and-Forget Guided Missile launcher, Death from above, literally.\nCaliber: 127mm Javelin FGM
LanguageData.Build_M320K.label: Build M320(K) Grenade Launcher
LanguageData.Build_M320K.description: Builds the M320(K) Grenade Launcher,good for CQC, keep a safe distance, you won't like 40mm grenade blast your face off.\nCaliber: 40x46mm Grenade
LanguageData.Build_HK69GL.label: Build HK69 Grenade Launcher
LanguageData.Build_HK69GL.description: Builds the HK69 Grenade Launcher, NICE.\nCaliber: 40x46mm Grenade
